name: @lucagiftzek/dsh-phone
description: Phone for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: SMS and calls in a sidebar tab (Twilio, SIP lines through an Asterisk relay), call audio through your server, live voicemail with transcripts, a Telegram account with chats, voice messages and calls, and phone_* and telegram_* agent tools.

scripts.test: node test/run.mjs && node test/dual.mjs && node test/relay.mjs && node test/errors.mjs && node test/doctor.mjs && node test/audio.mjs && node test/telegram.mjs && node test/tg-transcribe.mjs && node test/tg-calls.mjs
scripts.check: for f in lib/index.js lib/security.js lib/hookc.js daemon/hookd.mjs daemon/store.mjs daemon/twilio.mjs daemon/transcribe.mjs daemon/sip.mjs daemon/ami.mjs daemon/relay.mjs daemon/errors.mjs daemon/catalog.mjs daemon/plugin-errors.mjs daemon/audio.mjs daemon/audiosocket.mjs daemon/ws.mjs shared/g711.mjs shared/frame.mjs shared/jitter.mjs lib/errors.js lib/plugin-errors.js lib/plugin-skills.js lib/doctor.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && node test/run.mjs
